query:
SELECT name, content, buttonText, url, placement FROM cta_templates WHERE projectId = '1' AND isDefault = 1 LIMIT 5;
SELECT name, url FROM citation_sources WHERE projectId = '1' AND url NOT LIKE '%access-check%' AND url NOT LIKE '%example.com%' ORDER BY createdAt ASC LIMIT 20;
